# Signal Whistle (`equipment:signal-whistle`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 5 cp | **Weight:** 0 lb.

When blown as a Utilize action, a Signal Whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 600 feet away.
